goal: Replace the src/*.F90 implementation with Rust crates and a Rust CLI while preserving verified EarthMesh outputs for CoLM2024/CoLM20XX and coupled-model adapters.

phase_definitions.phase_0: Inventory, architecture decisions, and parity harnesses before behavior changes.
phase_definitions.phase_1: Replace external math and pure utility kernels with maintained Rust crates or small Rust geometry kernels.
phase_definitions.phase_2: Port configuration, mesh/data model, and file/NetCDF I/O boundaries.
phase_definitions.phase_3: Port area, containment, reference-target, and data-preprocess kernels behind fixture parity tests.
phase_definitions.phase_4: Port refinement, grid-quality, spring/icosahedron, and mask-postprocess kernels.
phase_definitions.phase_5: Replace mkgrd.x orchestration with Rust CLI/pipeline and remove the Fortran build dependency.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Linear algebra smoke tests cover every BLAS routine still reachable from EarthMesh kernels before the bundled BLAS source is removed.
fortran_sources.notes: Do not hand-translate vendored BLAS; select a maintained Rust/native math provider and keep only the call-level behavior that EarthMesh needs.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Rust config/state fixtures reproduce the same namelist defaults, constants, dimensions, and mode flags used by mkgrd.x.
fortran_sources.notes: This becomes typed shared state instead of global Fortran module variables.

typed FvcomMeshConfig defaults mirroring fvcommesh_coms:mesh_vars

full namelist read/write compatibility with mkgrd.F90 read_nl

fortran_sources.parity_gate: For representative NXP/NLEVEL fixtures, Rust matches node counts, connectivity counts, spherical coordinates within tolerance, and spring-quality summaries.
fortran_sources.notes: Keep deterministic ordering so downstream adapter snapshots remain stable.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Every LAPACK entry point used by EarthMesh has a Rust-side numerical parity smoke test and no direct dependency on bundled lapack.F90 remains.
fortran_sources.notes: The file is too large and too standard to port manually; replace with a maintained provider.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Rust CLI can run the same small smoke, Greater Bay Area, and China/MERIT workflows and reproduce required grid/mask/adapter outputs within documented tolerances.
fortran_sources.notes: This is the final orchestration cutover after lower-level kernels have parity gates.
completed_rust_surfaces: grid_xyz2lonlat scalar and batch coordinate conversion moved to rust/earthmesh_mesh
remaining_rust_surfaces: Rust CLI replacement for mkgrd.x end-to-end workflows

fortran_sources.notes: Build on the existing earthmesh_geometry crate and avoid duplicating polygon primitives.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Threshold, layer, and source-data preprocessing fixtures produce the same normalized arrays and metadata expected by refinement target selection.
fortran_sources.notes: This should align with the newer v3 hydro/coast data-source abstraction instead of preserving Fortran-only layout.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: NetCDF/text/binary fixture round-trips preserve dimensions, coordinate variables, masks, and adapter input/output fields byte-for-byte where formats permit.
fortran_sources.notes: Start with a narrow compatibility wrapper to stabilize I/O contracts, then port readers/writers into typed Rust modules.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Containment matrix fixtures match Fortran cell/source overlap assignments for structured and unstructured samples.
fortran_sources.notes: This is central to conservative remap/coupling support.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Land, ocean, atmosphere, and local refinement target fixtures reproduce Fortran refinement levels and mean/std calculations.
fortran_sources.notes: Keep target calculation decoupled from triangle/hex cell shape.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Grid-quality, adjacency, edge, ordering, lon/lat/xyz, triangle, polygon, and MPAS-order fixtures match Fortran outputs within tolerance.
fortran_sources.notes: This is one of the highest-risk business-kernel ports and should be split into small Rust modules with independent tests.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Atmosphere, Earth, land, ocean, MPAS, narrow-waterway, and final mask fixtures preserve role masks and adapter-facing classifications.
fortran_sources.notes: Must preserve the newer v3 requirement that every grid cell has an explicit mask and land/ocean roles remain distinguishable.

fortran_sources.parity_gate: Refinement-loop fixtures match split decisions, boundary connection behavior, weak-concavity handling, Delaunay flip outcomes, and final NGR renewal summaries.
fortran_sources.notes: Port after area/ref-target/containment parity is available; otherwise failures will be hard to isolate.
